title: chat-server: drop &str permission canon for ChatPermission
description: Follow-up from JMAP-do5p. jmap-chat-types now has ChatPermission (impl_string_enum!), but crate-jmap-chat-server/src/permissions.rs still exports a parallel pub const &str canon (MANAGE_SPACE, MANAGE_ROLES, MANAGE_MEMBERS, MANAGE_CHANNELS, PIN, BAN, MENTION_BROADCAST, VIEW, SEND; re-exported from lib.rs), RequiredPermissions::Known carries &'static [&'static str], and resolve_channel_permissions / ChatBackend::everyone_permissions plus the vtc, federation and filenode servers use HashSet<String> permission sets. JMAP-do5p's description asked for this canon to go; do5p kept it to limit the change to the five type-crate fields (consumers compare via ChatPermission::as_str()). Decide before the 0.4 freeze whether to (a) move these public surfaces to ChatPermission / HashSet<ChatPermission>, or (b) freeze them as wire strings. The ChatPermission::Other forging caveat (Other("view") != View) argues for keeping set membership on wire strings if (a) is chosen.
notes: Mark 2026-10-21: switch to the enum. Remove the &str permission constants; public permission APIs (RequiredPermissions, everyone_permissions, resolve_channel_permissions, consumers in vtc/federation/filenode servers) take/return ChatPermission. Internal set membership may still compare wire strings (as_str) so Other("view") never equals View.
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
